newsitem.title: BELGIUM: No decision expected on transparency mechanism.
newsitem.headline: No decision expected on transparency mechanism.

text.p: The Internal Market Council will on Friday hold a first discussion of the Commission's proposed mechanism for ensuring unnecessary legislation on things like protection of minors and pornography does not hinder the free flow of services in the information society.
But ahead of the meeting in Luxembourg diplomats said the Council would not take any decision at this early stage on COM (96) 392, which would amend directive 83/189/EEC.
Under the Commission Communication and proposed directive EU members would be obliged to notify the Commission of proposed legislation. It could then be discussed by member states.
If necessary legislation could be proposed on the basis of problems which occurred.
